name: @teactjs/telegram
description: Telegram platform adapter for Teact, powered by grammY

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external grammy --external @grammyjs/auto-retry --external @grammyjs/conversations --external @grammyjs/stream && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
